_readme: COPY THIS TO private/subscription-prices.json AND FILL IN YOUR OWN IDS.
It maps '<planId>:<billingPeriod>' to the payment provider's price id. It is
per-deployment and lives under private/ (which .gitignore anchors) because a
price id belongs to a merchant account, not to a source tree.
tools/subscribe-service.mjs REFUSES to start without it and refuses any map
whose mode is not exactly 'test'. That is not a formality: it is what stops a
live price id being reachable from a service whose whole contract is that it
cannot charge anyone. The absent file is a named refusal, never an empty map
-- 'no prices configured' and 'this plan has no price' are different failures.
The plan ids are the entitlement model's tier ids (src/lib/entitlement.js).
The periods are the ones the model actually prices: a plan with no annualUsd
gets no ':annual' entry, because there is no number to charge.
